SILT#00066: I just learned a quick keyboard shortcut for adding today's date or time now without manual entry or the `=TODAY()`/`=NOW()` copying hack. For date, it is `Ctrl`/`Cmd` + `;`. For time, it is `Ctrl`/`Cmd` + `:` (note: `:` = `Shift` + `;`). This seems to work for Calc, Sheets, and Excel
